incident-bot: Postmortem for INCIDENT-2026-03-20 uploaded: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-03-20
Jesse (SRE): Thanks — can we confirm customer-facing actions? We need status page copy + direct customer summary.
Rae (Comms): I can draft both. Quick Q: do we have consent to share the full RCA with affected customers?
Maya (Support): Customer A asked for the full RCA earlier. Legal flagged PII in logs.
Priya (Legal): We can't share raw logs. We can share a redacted RCA + timeline. For customers requesting full access, require a DPA addendum. I'll draft language.
Evan (Product): Timeline? We should aim to publish status page update within 24h, send affected-customer summary in 48h, and offer redacted RCA by EOD+5.
Jesse (SRE): +1. Also want to track recurrence patterns. Assigning SRE analytics to produce recurrence report in 7 days.
Maya (Support): I'll own the "affected-customer summary" email. Will need the redaction checklist from Legal and the comms template.
Priya (Legal): Redaction checklist: 1) remove IPs, 2) remove user identifiers, 3) no raw stack traces that contain customer data. I'll paste a short checklist below.
Priya (Legal): ```
Redaction checklist:
- Replace IPs with <REDACTED-IP>
- Replace user ids with <REDACTED-UID>
- Remove full request/response bodies
- Summarize stack traces, no raw UUIDs
```
Rae (Comms): Draft status page blurb proposal:
Rae (Comms): ```
Status page (public):
We experienced a service disruption impacting inference requests between 03:12–03:47 UTC. Root cause: autoscaling bug causing GPU pool starvation. Impact: increased latency and 5xx errors for a subset of customers. Mitigation: rollback and rolling restarts completed at 03:47 UTC. Next steps: full RCA available to affected customers on request.
```
Evan (Product): Suggest adding a short sentence about reducing blast radius by failing over to a dedicated variant — keep public wording concise.
Jesse (SRE): Action items: 1) Rae - publish status page update (24h). 2) Maya - send affected-customer summaries (48h). 3) Priya - redaction checklist and consent language (24h). 4) Jordan (SRE-Analytics) - recurrence report (7d). 5) Jesse - add RCA sharing policy to postmortem (EOD+5). Please ack with emoji and set ownership in the tracker.
Jordan (SRE-Analytics): I got this. Will pull incident history and return a 7d trend + suggested mitigations.
Maya (Support): Ack. Will coordinate with Sales for customers on enterprise contracts.
Rae (Comms): I'll put drafts in the shared folder and ping here when ready: https://redwood.internal/commspipeline/INC-2026-03-20
incident-bot: Reminder set: Rae to post status page in 24h, Maya to send customer summaries in 48h.
Jesse (SRE): One more: let's schedule a short sync tomorrow 10am PT to review drafts. Calendar invite incoming.
Maya (Support): :thumbsup:
Priya (Legal): :thumbsup: Will review drafts ASAP.
Rae (Comms): Thanks team. I'll iterate and post the first draft within 4 hours.
